tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GRP2603 Basic HD IP Phone With Adapter is a professional business communication solution designed for small offices, enterprises, call centers, and remote work environments. Featuring support for 3 lines and 6 SIP accounts, this IP phone delivers crystal-clear HD voice quality, advanced security features, and reliable performance for daily business communications.


Equipped with a large backlit LCD display, dual Fast Ethernet ports, and 5-way audio conferencing, the Grandstream GRP2603 enhances productivity and collaboration. Its support for Grandstream Device Management System (GDMS) allows easy cloud provisioning, monitoring, and centralized management, making it an ideal choice for growing businesses.


Whether you need a dependable VoIP phone for office desks, customer service teams, or corporate communication systems, the Grandstream GRP2603 offers excellent value, performance, and reliability.


Key Features


  • Supports 3 lines and 6 SIP accounts
  • HD audio quality on handset and speakerphone
  • 2.8-inch color backlit LCD display
  • Dual 10/100 Mbps Ethernet ports
  • 5-way audio conferencing
  • Full-duplex speakerphone with advanced noise reduction
  • Enterprise-level security protection
  • GDMS cloud management and provisioning
  • Electronic Hook Switch (EHS) support for wireless headsets
  • Wall-mountable design
  • Power adapter included
